items.text: plan change karna hai
balance check kro
offers kya hai
nahi samajh aaya
check karo
upgrade karna hai

items.context: Aapko kab plan change karna hai?
items.text: haan ji kab karna hai

items.context: Kya aap turant plan upgrade karna chahte hain?
items.text: nahi abhi mujhe thik hai

items.context: Kya aapko plan ke charges check karne hain?
items.text: bill kat gaya hai
mera plan prepaid se postpaid me change karna hai
kya aapke paas Mumbai me koi special data pack hai
maine suna hai ki naye plans me unlimited calls free hain
please mujhe apne sabse sasta internet plan ke bare me bataye
mera naam rajesh kumar hai aur main delhi me rehta hu
main apne plan ka validity badhana chahta hu kyunki usage zyada hai
aap mujhe bata sakte hain ki naye plans me kya kya free hai

items.context: Kya aap prepaid plan change karna chahenge?
items.text: hai ji main prepaid plan me interested hu

items.context: Kaunsa data pack check karna hai aapko?
items.text: jis plan me 2gb daily data mile wo price kya hai

items.context: Aapke location ke hisab se plan bata raha hun
items.text: main Kolkata me rehta hu aur local network ke offers jana chahta hu

items.context: Aapko call quality ya data speed me problem aa rahi hai?
items.text: kya call drops ke liye bhi koi special plan hai

items.context: Kya aap apna existing plan upgrade karna chahenge?
items.text: main apne current plan ko upgrade kar ke more data lena chahta hu
mera address hai Mumbai mai Bandra west ke pass aur mai apne prepaid plan me changes karna chahta hu
kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain ki mera plan change karne ke baad mujhe kitna charge lagega
mera account number 9955667744 hai aur main naye offers ke liye kisi cheaper plan me switch karna chahta hu

items.context: Kya aapko apne plan me additional data add karna hai?
items.text: mera current plan 399 ka hai aur main data limit badhana chahta hu aapke pass koi option hai zyada data ke liye

items.context: Aap kis city me rehte hain jaha se plan lena chahte hain?
items.text: kya aap mujhe Hyderabad ke liye koi short term plan bata sakte hain jisme free calls aur 3gb data mile

items.context: Kya aap kisi family plan ke baare me janna chahte hain?
items.text: mera mobile number 9876543210 hai aur main apne family ko better plan dena chah raha hu jisme sab ke liye benefit ho

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: plan_change - wants to change or understand a plan
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
